PRACTICE AREA / 01

Criminal law.

Representation in criminal proceedings informed by an extensive background in investigation, evidence and procedure.

SCOPE OF WORK

From first records to final arguments.

Criminal matters call for close attention to the investigation record, the legal elements of an offence and the evidence that can properly be placed before a court.

The practice includes trials, bail and anticipatory bail, appeals, revisions, quashing petitions and related criminal proceedings. Each matter is assessed on its own facts and the applicable law.

01

Pre-trial & bail

Bail and anticipatory bail, charge-sheet review, discharge and charge framing.

02

Trial advocacy

Witness examination, cross-examination, evidentiary objections and final arguments.

03

Appellate work

Appeals, revisions, quashing and related proceedings.

QUESTIONS OF EVIDENCE

Investigation knowledge in legal practice.

Experience with documentary and electronic records, forensic and medical material, witness credibility and circumstantial evidence informs a methodical approach to criminal litigation.
